$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_gui_diag.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from ctypes import wintypes as w
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

class GUID(c.Structure):
    _fields_=[("Data1",c.c_uint32),("Data2",c.c_uint16),("Data3",c.c_uint16),("Data4",c.c_ubyte*8)]
def guid(s):
    import uuid
    return GUID.from_buffer_copy(uuid.UUID(s).bytes_le)
ids={
"Desktop":"B4BFCC3A-DB2C-424C-B029-7FE99A87C641",
"Documents":"FDD39AD0-238F-46AF-ADB4-6C85480369C7",
"Downloads":"374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B",
"Pictures":"33E28130-4E1E-4676-835A-98395C3BC3BB",
"Music":"4BD8D571-6D19-48D3-BE97-422220080E43",
"Videos":"18989B1D-99B5-455B-841C-AB7C74E4DDFC",
}
shell32=c.windll.shell32
ole32=c.windll.ole32
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.argtypes=[c.POINTER(GUID),w.DWORD,w.HANDLE,c.POINTER(c.c_wchar_p)]
shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath.restype=c.c_long
ole32.CoTaskMemFree.argtypes=[c.c_void_p]
for name,g in ids.items():
    out=c.c_wchar_p()
    hr=shell32.SHGetKnownFolderPath(c.byref(guid(g)),0,None,c.byref(out))
    path=out.value if hr>=0 and out.value else ""
    if out.value: ole32.CoTaskMemFree(c.cast(out,c.c_void_p))
    print("KNOWN_PATH",name,repr(path),"EXISTS",Path(path).exists() if path else False,
          "PARENT",repr(str(Path(path).parent) if path else ""),flush=True)

profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
print("PROFILE",repr(str(profile)),flush=True)
for p in sorted(profile.iterdir(),key=lambda x:x.name.lower()):
    print("PROFILE_CHILD",repr(p.name),"DIR",p.is_dir(),flush=True)

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-diagnostic"
if owned.exists(): shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy(); env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata")
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
win=None
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        if proc.poll() is not None: break
        ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x.window_text()]
        if len(ws)==1: win=ws[0]; break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win: raise RuntimeError("flyExplorer window unavailable")
    time.sleep(3)
    pane=win.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
    rows=[x for x in pane.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]
    print("FLY_ROW_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    for row in rows[:50]:
        print("FLY_ROW",repr(row.element_info.name or row.window_text()),flush=True)
        for img in [x for x in row.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="Image"]:
            print("FLY_ROW_IMAGE",repr(img.element_info.name),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if win: c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
        try: proc.wait(timeout=8)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.terminate(); proc.wait(timeout=5)
print("FLY_EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
